_assumptions.jacket: RR-HD-S-131/132 fitted below 0 C (standard cold configuration); no-jacket shown

thermal._option: Option set-point +5 C (labelled option, not the baseline): head_afe_budget.md section 3.2 shows the lowest usable BETA_LLD falling with temperature (8-9 p.e. at +10 C, 7-8 at -20 C) and crosstalk-limited below about 0 C, so +5 C costs no threshold against +10 C; +5 C is also inside the +5..+10 C bond-line range assumed for the OEM modules (head_report.md section 8). It is NOT chosen as the baseline because the OEM carrier / bond-line limits are unknown (no OEM drawing) and the project uses +10 C.
